overview: The Council unanimously appointed Frederick Lasky to the Community Garden Commission and approved resolutions regarding school security protocols, water monitoring software, and street sweeping efficiency. Several significant loan orders for public works and building remodeling were tabled for further review.

items.title: Community Garden Commission Appointment
items.summary: Unanimously appointed Frederick Lasky as the Council's representative to the newly ordained Garden Commission for a three-year term.

items.title: Raised Crosswalk Pilot Program Update
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on the installation of raised crosswalks on Central Avenue and Harvard Street and requested repairs for a sunken trench at Central and Spring Streets.

items.title: Water Monitoring and Leak Detection Software
items.summary: Approved a resolution to discuss the new Water Smart monitoring program and requested a financial report from the Water and Sewer Commission regarding the water account deficit and surplus.

items.title: DPW and Brooks Estate Loan Orders
items.summary: Tabled three loan orders totaling $850,000 for DPW facility funds, Winthrop Street, and Brooks Estate remodeling because no detailed project information was provided.

items.title: School Security Guards and Safety Protocols
items.summary: Approved a request for cost estimates to hire school security guards and called for a joint meeting with the School Committee following a theft incident at the McGlynn School.

items.title: Street Sweeping Program Analysis
items.summary: Requested a cost-benefit analysis of internal versus contracted street sweeping services and discussed concerns regarding the timing and notification effectiveness of the current program.

items.title: Building Department Prior Years' Bills
items.summary: Approved the payment of $2,006.74 for unpaid 2015 maintenance bills relating to Council Chamber air conditioning and boiler repairs.

items.title: Common Victualler License and Free Speech Petition
items.summary: Approved a food license for Fruition at 472 High Street and referred a petition regarding the free speech rights of public speakers to the Committee on Rules.

items.title: Medical Marijuana Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Referred a proposed zoning amendment regarding safe access to medical marijuana to the Committee of the Whole for review with department heads and the city solicitor.

items.title: Marine Corps Birthday, Riverside Crosswalk, and Councilor-Elects
items.summary: Recognized the Marine Corps birthday, requested painting for the 510 Riverside Avenue crosswalk, and invited Councilor-elects Falco and Scarpelli to attend future meetings.

items.title: December Free Parking Proposal
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting free parking during the month of December to support local businesses, despite concerns regarding the financial impact on Park Medford contracts.

items.title: Craddock Bridge Construction and Medford Square Bus Stops
items.summary: Requested an immediate meeting with the MBTA and construction officials regarding unannounced bridge activity and problematic bus stop locations in Medford Square.

items.title: Fells Plaza Metal Container Removal
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting property owners at Fells Plaza remove a metal donation box due to persistent illegal dumping and trash accumulation.
